The '''''Stormwind''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jarroth]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It patrolled the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] for rebellious activity from the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]], which was fighting against the Imperial-aligned ruling government, the [[Aristocracy]], in the [[Virgillian Civil War]]. It also searched for potential [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] activity in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==Description==
The ''Stormwind'' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It had [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and communications equipment able to receive transmissions.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==History==
[[File:Virgillia-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Stormwind'' patrolled the Virgillia system.]]
The ''Stormwind'' served as a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] that was part of a small Imperial Navy [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] patrolling the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. During the [[Virgillian Civil War]], its aim was stopping the anti-[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Imperial]] [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] from rebelling against the [[Aristocracy]], which controlled the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and was aligned with the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> After the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Stormwind'' searched for suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strongholds in the system.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|141|Jarroth, Captain}}</ref>

Sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="4 ABY">The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was founded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'' establishes that the [[Virgillian Civil War]] between the [[Aristocracy]] and the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] ended just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Since the book also states that the Empire's ''Stormwind'' was searching for Free Alignment fighters during the war, the event must have taken place between those two dates.</ref> the ''Stormwind'' received a transmission from an Imperial informant present in the system, saying that they had found evidence of a suspected Free Alignment encampment on [[Virgillia's forested moon]]. Although the encampment was in fact a [[Unidentified refugee camp|refugee camp]] with no Free Alignment connections, the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] on the order of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jarroth]], who [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the ship, when they went to investigate. When the Galactic Civil War intensified, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] withdrew from the Virgillia system.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Stormwind'' was commanded by Captain Jarroth during the reign of the Galactic Empire. The crew included [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Rannd Delckis]], who served as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications assistant]], and the ship also carried stormtroopers.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Stormwind'' was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
